request: Review the Skill system in the supplied directory and optimize it into a better version.
context: The directory is available to the Agent and contains the complete Skill system.
The user has not prepared a Manifest, Cases, or Review Session.
must_behaviors: Inspect the complete supplied system without delegating internal setup to the user
Identify the highest-impact system problem before editing
Create changes only in an isolated Candidate and preserve the source
Run a comparable before-and-after evaluation when available or label behavioral impact unverified
Return the Candidate location, reviewable Diff, and supporting evidence
must_not_behaviors: Ask the user to prepare a Manifest, Cases, JSON Results, or CLI commands that the Agent can prepare
Claim observed behavioral improvement without comparable execution evidence
Return only instructions for operating the evaluation framework
rationale: Protects the primary product experience: the user supplies a Skill system and receives a reviewable improved Candidate without operating the internal evaluation machinery.
